newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Seven killed in clash, gun accident in Mogadishu.
newsitem.headline: Seven killed in clash, gun accident in Mogadishu.

text.p: At least two people were killed in clashes between militiamen in south Mogadishu on Thursday and five civilians were killed when a gun was fired accidentally, witnesses said.

They said two people were killed and three wounded when mortar bombs slammed into buildings in the Bulo Hubey district of south Mogadishu during fighting between militiamen loyal to faction leaders Hussein Aideed and Osman Hassan Ali Atto.
In a separate incident, an anti-tank gun mounted on a truck was fired by accident in south Mogadishu and four civilian men and a woman standing in front of a shop were killed and five were wounded.
Somalia has had no central government and has been divided into fiefdoms controlled by rival militia forces since the overthrow of the late dictator Mohamed Siad Barre in 1991.
